project_type: Greenfield pure vanilla HTML/CSS/JS web app — no build step, no framework, no package manager
language: HTML5, CSS3, ES5-compatible JavaScript (IIFE pattern throughout)
build_system: None. Files are served directly from filesystem. All paths must work from file:// protocol. CDN scripts loaded from unpkg/cdnjs.
test_framework: None. Verification is manual: open HTML files in a browser, check DevTools console for errors, interact with features.
build_command: N/A — open index.html or app.html directly in a browser
test_command: N/A — manual browser testing. Check DevTools console is clean, all features interactive.
verification_instructions: 1. Open d:\Anti-LinkedIn\index.html in browser. 2. Confirm hero section, waitlist form, live certificate preview, and 3 feature cards render. 3. Type into cert textarea — preview updates in real time. 4. Submit waitlist form — counter decrements, success message appears. 5. Click Download PNG — .png file downloads. 6. Open d:\Anti-LinkedIn\app.html in browser. 7. Confirm all 5 bottom nav items work (Beranda, Buat Sambat, Avatar, Toko, Profil). 8. Feed tab: 5 dummy posts visible. 9. Create tab: type banned phrase, verify button disables and warning appears. Post valid post, verify it appears on feed. 10. Avatar tab: select each of 4 characters, verify SVG changes. Toggle accessories. 11. Toko tab: 4 items visible, click Beli, QRIS modal appears with QR pattern, confirm purchase fires confetti and shows toast. 12. Profil tab: avatar, username, level, XP bar, stats visible. 13. No console errors throughout.
environment_constraints: Windows environment. All file paths use backslash on filesystem but forward slash in HTML src/href attributes. CDN URLs: html2canvas from https://html2canvas.hertzen.com/dist/html2canvas.min.js or unpkg; canvas-confetti from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.9.2/dist/confetti.browser.min.js. Google Fonts loaded via <link> in <head>. No server required — file:// protocol only.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists (greenfield project). Follow the plan.md architecture exactly. Each FEAT must leave the codebase in a working state. Commit each FEAT with the exact commit message specified.
key_patterns: 1. All JS files use IIFE pattern: (function(){ 'use strict'; ... window.ModuleName = { ... }; })(); 2. Inter-module communication via localStorage (keys prefixed sambatin_) and CustomEvent on window. 3. SVG avatars use only SVG primitives (circle, rect, polygon, path, ellipse, line, text) — no emoji for character body parts. 4. CSS uses custom properties defined in main.css :root, consumed in landing.css and app.css. 5. Mobile-first CSS: base styles for 320px, breakpoint at min-width:768px. 6. All modals use: add/remove 'hidden' attribute, #modal-overlay shown as shared backdrop. 7. LocalStorage keys reference table is in plan.md — use those exact key names.
directory_structure: d:\Anti-LinkedIn\ (root — index.html, app.html live here), styles\ (main.css, landing.css, app.css), js\ (all 7 JS modules), .agents\tasks\ (artifact files — NEVER committed to the app).
